name: Lemon Cherry Gelato
summary: **Lemon Cherry Gelato** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] from the California brand [[breeder:Backpackboyz]], a cross of [[sunset-sherbet|Sunset Sherbet]] and [[gsc|GSC]]. Backpackboyz debuted it at a Cookies dispensary in Los Angeles in late 2019. Some sources add an unidentified third parent.
